SELECT P.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, NVL(P.BID_PBANC_NO, P.BF_SPEC_RGST_NO) AS pbancNo, P.PBANC_STEP_CD AS pbancStepCd, STEP.CD_NM AS pbancStepNm, P.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, P.ORDER_INST_NM AS orderInstNm, P.ALTMNT_BGT_AMT AS altmntBgtAmt, P.BID_DDLN_DT AS bidDdlnDt, TEAM.TEAM_NM AS sprvsnTeamNm, ( SELECT LISTAGG(JT.TEAM_NM, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY JT.TEAM_NM) FROM TB_PTCP_TEAM PT JOIN TB_TEAM JT ON JT.TEAM_SN = PT.TEAM_SN WHERE PT.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN ) AS joinTeamNms, P.PBANC_STTS_CD AS pbancSttsCd, STTS.CD_NM AS pbancSttsNm, RTRN.CD_NM AS rtrnSeNm FROM TB_BID_PBANC P LEFT JOIN TB_TEAM TEAM ON TEAM.TEAM_SN = P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD STEP ON STEP.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTP' AND STEP.CD = P.PBANC_STEP_CD LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD STTS ON STTS.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTS' AND STTS.CD = P.PBANC_STTS_CD LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD RTRN ON RTRN.GROUP_CD = 'RTRSE' AND RTRN.CD = P.RTRN_SE_CD
ORDER BY P.REG_DT DESC, P.PBANC_SN DESC
ORDER BY P.BID_DDLN_DT ASC NULLS LAST, P.PBANC_SN ASC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT C.CD AS sttsCd, C.CD_NM AS sttsNm, NVL(N.CNT, 0) AS cnt FROM TB_COM_CD C LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PBANC_STTS_CD, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TB_BID_PBANC GROUP BY PBANC_STTS_CD ) N ON N.PBANC_STTS_CD = C.CD WHERE C.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTS' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY C.SORT_SEQ
